In brief

Baharath Bathula is a Senior Technical Architect at Acord AI, where he designs an AI-enabled insurance Agency Management System. He is an IEEE Senior Member, the author of two books on data and AI, and the creator of an open-source self-healing data pipeline framework.

Insurance CRM

AIVA CRM

A multi-tenant CRM for insurance agencies. Its agents answer new leads, follow up on quotes and start renewals, and a person approves each message.

Document intelligence

AIOS

Real estate operations

Real Estate Ops

An operations platform for real estate brokerages in Dubai: six checks on every request, the listing rules built into the workflow, in English and Arabic. A prototype.

Open project

Open-source research

Self-Healing Data Pipelines

When a pipeline breaks, a rule answers first. A failure is matched against a short YAML rulebook that names the cause, picks a response and a fallback.

  • YAML rulebook
  • MIT licence
  • Patent application in preparation
Open project

Agentic operations

AI Ops Copilot

An agent loop that stops and asks before it acts. It plans, gathers evidence, proposes a fix and critiques its own answer. Anything risky waits for a person.

  • LangGraph
  • 14-node workflow
  • Human in the loop
Open project

Quantum computing

Quantum Concepts

Nine quantum concepts, and every claim is a test. A popular nine-card infographic rebuilt as working Qiskit code, with an autograded take-home around it.

  • Qiskit
  • 110 project tests
  • Autograder
Open project

Photonic computing

Photonlab

A NumPy simulator of photonic chips. It programs real matrices onto simulated interferometer meshes, adds the errors real chips have, and measures what survives, energy included.

  • NumPy
  • 72 tests
  • Energy model
Open project
